title: Twin Falls Resort State Park Sprayground & Pro Shop
overview: A new golf pro shop and a bathhouse with a 15-feature touch-activated sprayground, both requiring power and telecom brought from the lodge with utility coordination. The pro shop houses retail, offices, and locker/shower rooms; the sprayground's filters, pumps, and controls sit in a pre-fabricated enclosure; and the bathhouse adds restrooms, showers, and a ticket office.
